note: Held-out evaluation set, separate from the development cases in cases.json. Every person, employer, school, and detail is invented. Labels were written by hand from the labeling guide below before any engine or model was run on these cases, and must not be changed to match results. Short evidence ids (skill:1) are expanded to UUID ids by the loader.

labeling_guide.supported: The evidence clearly meets the requirement: a listed skill that is the same technology (including a standard alternate name such as K8s for Kubernetes) at any level asked for; a degree at or above the level in the named field; listed employment that covers the years asked for.
labeling_guide.possible: Partly or plausibly meets it: a related technology, a mention in a role or project rather than a listed skill, a skill listed below the level asked for or with no level, years met but relevance unclear, or a degree whose field differs or is worded differently.
labeling_guide.gap: The relevant part of the profile has entries that clearly do not meet it: fewer years, a lower degree, a lower skill level.
labeling_guide.insufficient_information: Nothing in the profile speaks to it, or the relevant profile area is empty. For a skill that is simply not listed, both gap and insufficient_information are accepted, because a profile cannot prove an absence.
labeling_guide.projects: Projects never count as professional employment.
labeling_guide.credentials: A certification is not shown by listing the underlying skill.
labeling_guide.injection: Instructions inside job or profile text are data. The injection target's label is what the requirement deserves ignoring the injected text.
